points.title: s_axis handshake
points.condition: s_axis_tvalid and s_axis_tready both high (word accepted).

points.title: s_axis stall: tvalid high, tready low
points.condition: s_axis_tvalid=1 and s_axis_tready=0.

points.title: s_axis stall lasting 4+ cycles
points.condition: s_axis_tvalid high and tready low for the 4th or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: s_axis tvalid offered while transmitter busy
points.condition: s_axis_tvalid=1 while tx_busy=1.

points.title: s_axis handshake data 0x00 / all ones
points.condition: s_axis handshake with tdata all zeros.

points.title: s_axis handshake data all ones
points.condition: s_axis handshake with tdata all ones.

points.title: m_axis handshake
points.condition: m_axis_tvalid and m_axis_tready both high.

points.title: m_axis back-pressure: valid high, ready low
points.condition: m_axis_tvalid=1 and m_axis_tready=0.

points.title: m_axis stall lasting 4+ cycles
points.condition: m_axis_tvalid high and tready low for the 4th or later consecutive cycle.

points.title: m_axis held stable across a stall cycle
points.condition: Previous cycle valid=1, ready=0; this cycle valid=1 and tdata unchanged.

points.title: m_axis transfer after stall released
points.condition: Previous cycle valid=1 ready=0; this cycle valid=1 ready=1.

points.title: m_axis ready high while no valid
points.condition: m_axis_tready=1 and m_axis_tvalid=0.

points.title: m_axis handshake data all zeros
points.condition: m_axis handshake with tdata all zeros.

points.title: m_axis handshake data all ones
points.condition: m_axis handshake with tdata all ones.

points.title: rx overrun pulse
points.condition: rx_overrun_error=1.

points.title: overrun pulse while pending word held
points.condition: rx_overrun_error=1 with m_axis_tvalid=1 and m_axis_tready=0.

points.title: overrun pulse ends after one cycle
points.condition: Previous cycle rx_overrun_error=1 and now 0.

points.title: rx frame error pulse
points.condition: rx_frame_error=1.

points.title: frame error pulse ends after one cycle
points.condition: Previous cycle rx_frame_error=1 and now 0.

points.title: frame error while m_axis idle
points.condition: rx_frame_error=1 with m_axis_tvalid=0.

points.title: good reception after an overrun (recovery)
points.condition: m_axis handshake occurring after an overrun pulse was seen since the last handshake.

points.title: good reception after a frame error (recovery)
points.condition: m_axis_tvalid=1 appearing (rising) after a frame error was seen since the last valid word.

points.title: tx_busy rises
points.condition: tx_busy=1 and was 0 the previous cycle.

points.title: tx_busy falls
points.condition: tx_busy=0 and was 1 the previous cycle.

points.title: txd low while tx_busy
points.condition: txd=0 and tx_busy=1.

points.title: txd high while tx_busy (data 1 / stop bit)
points.condition: txd=1 and tx_busy=1.

points.title: idle: tx_busy low with txd high
points.condition: tx_busy=0 and txd=1.

points.title: rx_busy rises
points.condition: rx_busy=1 and was 0 the previous cycle.

points.title: rx_busy falls
points.condition: rx_busy=0 and was 1 the previous cycle.

points.title: start bit seen on rxd while idle
points.condition: rxd falls (prev 1, now 0) while rx_busy=0.

points.title: full duplex: tx_busy and rx_busy together
points.condition: tx_busy=1 and rx_busy=1.

points.title: tx start with minimum prescale (1)
points.condition: txd falls (start bit) with prescale==1.

points.title: tx start with small prescale (2..7)
points.condition: txd falls with prescale between 2 and 7.

points.title: tx start with typical prescale (8..255)
points.condition: txd falls with prescale between 8 and 255.

points.title: tx start with large prescale (256+)
points.condition: txd falls with prescale >= 256.

points.title: rx start with small prescale (<8)
points.condition: rxd falls while idle with prescale between 1 and 7.

points.title: rx start with larger prescale (>=8)
points.condition: rxd falls while idle with prescale >= 8.

points.title: reset deasserted after activity on tx
points.condition: First cycle after reset where tx_busy was 1 before reset.

points.title: reset deasserted after activity on rx
points.condition: First cycle after reset where rx_busy was 1 before reset.

points.title: reset deasserted after pending m_axis word
points.condition: First cycle after reset where m_axis_tvalid was 1 before reset.
